theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_holder_succ_iff_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (m : ℕ) (α : ℝ) (f : Rn n → E) (U : Set (Rn n)), IsOpen U → (((ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1 : ℕ) f U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ↔ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fderiv ℝ f) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α)) ∧ ((ContDiffOn ℝ (m + 1 : ℕ) f U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ (m + 1) f y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) ↔ (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f U ∧ ∀ k : Fin n, ContDiffOn ℝ m (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) U ∧ ∀ K : Set (Rn n), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ y ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) x - iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (fun z => fderiv ℝ f z (EuclideanSpace.single k (1 : ℝ))) y‖ ≤ C * ‖x - y‖ ^ α)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
